items.description: Report does not give a numeric definition of open-interest inflation/deflation; counters_reflect_reachable_only is a qualitative Boolean whose numeric binding is deferred to code binding.
Report does not give concrete magnitudes or numeric ranges for open-interest inflation/deflation, so the misstatement is represented as a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric relation.
Report does not state whether the actor orphaning liquidity is unauthorized or privileged; the requirement is kept general over the append/removal flow.
